summary: Columbia County lookout: 1912 tree platform, 1941 99-ft wooden L-6 tower, destroyed in the October 1962 Columbus Day storm. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 99' wooden L-6 tower (1941) replacing a 135' tree platform; cab 8x8 per Forest Lookouts' 1941 entry, 7x7 per its May 1942 inspection report
facts.status_note: Destroyed in the October 12, 1962 Columbus Day storm; remaining buildings salvaged in 1966. No source describes what remains on the site.

notes_for_editor: Main history agrees across all three sources. Cab size conflicts: Forest Lookouts gives 8x8 in its 1941 entry and 7x7 in the May 1942 inspection report; the story reports both and does not choose. Staff names come from 1942-43 entries on Forest Lookouts (quoting period newspapers and reports); the 1954 observer is deliberately not named. No source describes what remains today or public access; the one web search surfaced storm coverage only, not site status. The 'Activated ... Portland Filter Center' note on Forest Lookouts is quoted as written and not explained further.
